Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one — Marcus Aurelius
Think of the life you have lived until now as over, and what remains as a bonus; live it according to Nature — Marcus Aurelius
It never ceases to amaze me: we all love ourselves more than other people, but care more about their opinion than our own — Marcus Aurelius
In your actions, don’t procrastinate; in your life, don’t be all about business — Marcus Aurelius
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it — Marcus Aurelius
The best revenge is not to be like your enemy — Marcus Aurelius
Choose not to be harmed — and you won’t feel harmed. Don’t feel harmed — and you haven’t been — Marcus Aurelius
It’s time you realized that you have something in you more powerful and miraculous than the things that affect you — Marcus Aurelius
External things are not the problem. It’s your assessment of them — Marcus Aurelius
If anyone can show me I’m making a mistake, I’ll gladly change. It’s the truth I’m after — Marcus Aurelius
You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think — Marcus Aurelius
Be tolerant with others and strict with yourself — Marcus Aurelius
We are more often frightened than hurt; and we suffer more in imagination than in reality — Seneca
If a man knows not which port he sails, no wind is favorable — Seneca
It is in your power not to want what you don’t have, and to use cheerfully what you do have — Seneca
Nothing is a better proof of a well-ordered mind than a man’s ability to spend time in his own company — Seneca
He who fears death will never do anything worthy of a man who is alive — Seneca
Life is very short and anxious for those who forget the past, neglect the present, and fear the future — Seneca
I judge you unfortunate because you have never lived through misfortune — Seneca
How does it help to make troubles heavier by bemoaning them? — Seneca
People are frugal in guarding property; but in wasting time they are most wasteful — Seneca
How long are you going to wait before you demand the best for yourself? — Epictetus
Wish that everything happens as it actually will — then your life will flow well — Epictetus
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do — Epictetus
Curb your desire — don’t set your heart on so many things and you will get what you need — Epictetus
Don’t be satisfied with mere learning, but add practice and training — Epictetus
Don’t explain your philosophy. Embody it — Epictetus
Identify what is under your control and which have to do with the choices I actually control — Epictetus
If anyone tells you a person speaks ill of you, do not defend yourself. They are ignorant of your other faults — Epictetus
I would rather die having spoken in my manner, than speak in your manner and live — Socrates
The unexamined life is not worth living — Socrates
If you want to be wrong then follow the masses — Socrates
Falling down is not a failure. Failure comes when you stay where you have fallen — Socrates
I don’t care what people say about me; I care about my mistakes — Socrates
Know thyself — Socrates
The only true wisdom is in knowing that you know nothing — Socrates
Remember, no human condition is ever permanent — Socrates
The secret of happiness is not found in seeking more, but in developing the capacity to enjoy less — Socrates
It is better to make a mistake with full force of your being than to avoid mistakes with a trembling spirit — Socrates
To find yourself, think for yourself — Socrates
We cannot live better than in seeking to become better — Socrates
Wonder is the feeling of a philosopher, and philosophy begins in wonder — Socrates
It is not living that matters, but living rightly — Socrates
Being deeply loved gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage — Lao Tzu
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step — Lao Tzu
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom — Lao Tzu
Life is a series of changes. Don’t resist them; that only creates sorrow — Lao Tzu
A good traveler has no fixed plans and is not intent on arriving — Lao Tzu
Those who know do not speak. Those who speak do not know — Lao Tzu
When you don’t compare or compete, everyone will respect you — Lao Tzu
The best fighter is never angry — Lao Tzu
If you are at peace you are living in the present — Lao Tzu
Because one believes in oneself, one doesn’t try to convince others — Lao Tzu
A man with inner courage dares to live — Lao Tzu
Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner — Lao Tzu
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished — Lao Tzu
Be content with what you have; rejoice in the way things are — Lao Tzu
At the center of your being you have the answer; you know who you are — Lao Tzu
Do you have the patience to wait until your mud settles and the water is clear? — Lao Tzu
Silence is a source of great strength — Lao Tzu
Kindness in thinking creates profoundness; kindness in giving creates love — Lao Tzu
Manifest plainness; embrace simplicity; reduce selfishness; have few desires — Lao Tzu
A leader is best when people barely know he exists — Lao Tzu
Music in the soul can be heard by the universe — Lao Tzu
Act without expectation — Lao Tzu
Persist in the face of obstacles; they are blessings in disguise — Carol S. Dweck
Successful people are always stretching themselves to learn new things — Carol S. Dweck
Your brain is like a muscle that gets stronger as you use it — Carol S. Dweck
Leaders are made, not born, through their own drive for self-improvement — Carol S. Dweck
You don’t know what your abilities are until you make a full commitment to developing them — Carol S. Dweck
Happiness shall depend as little as possible on external things — Epictetus
Happiness is governed by our mental attitude — Dale Carnegie
Changing your life starts with changing the way you see everything in your life — Mark Manson
The pressure of adversity does not affect the mind of the brave man — Seneca
Your love is not outside; it is deep within you. You can never lose it — Eckhart Tolle
Beauty comes in all forms. It’s not just external; it’s internal as well — Alessia Cara
